recent.text: Anthony Mantha underwent surgery on his throat injury. He had a fracture in his throat. Sheldon Keefe called it a rare injury. Expecting to be about a month out, but that will be flexible given the rarity. Mantha took a cross check to the throat on Long Island last week.
